notes.subject: אם אברה חסידה ונצה
notes.rationale: Divergent readings: 'are they the stork's pinion and plumage?' (JPS) vs 'the ostrich or the hawk' (YLT, repointing חסידה as חסידה/hawk); literal kept.

notes.subject: נעלסה
notes.rationale: עלס 'flap exultantly' appears only here in the Tanakh.

notes.subject: רננים
notes.rationale: Literal 'wailer' — the ostrich named from its wail; transliterated, not rendered.

translation: Renanim (renanim) ka jakɛ bɛ diya-frajera, yala a bɛ hasida (hasida) ka jakɛ ni jakɛ-nɛrɛmɛw ye wa?
